resourceName: Shaanxi Foping Improved Forest Management Project
description:
The Shaanxi Foping Improved Forest Management Project (hereafter referred to as “the project”) is located in Foping County, Hanzhong City, Shaanxi Province, P.R.China. It is implemented by China Carbon Sinks Holdings Limited (PP) to protect the once logging forest. 
The proposed project is implemented in Chenjiaba Town, Daheba Town, Yueba Town, Yuanjiazhuang Town, Xichahe Town. The project has 7,011ha commercial forest, whose ages ranging from sapling, middle age to mature forest. Prior to the implementation of the project, Forests in the project area were harvested following the guidelines in Timber Harvest Plan approved by the local forestry bureau. In order to protect the forest ecosystem, improve the ecological environment, increase carbon sinks, reduce GHG emission reductions and slow down climate change, the project proponent decided to implement this improved forest management project activities from December 2017 to December 2047. And from the Project Start Date, PP has stopped the commercial logging in the project area.
This project aims to protect 7011ha commercial forest from logging. The Forest Conservation Project activities will be focused on forest resource supervision and monitoring. In order to supervise and monitor any disturbances that may affect the whole forest, a ranger team has been established to monitor the state of the forest with regard to diseases, illegal logging, hunting, fires etc. This ecosystem will then continue to provide its services to all the communities and entities that depend on it.
The estimated annual revoval and emission reductions are 41,521 tonnes of CO2e .The project activity will significantly improve the forest management conditions within the project area, and benefit local ecological environment.
